newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up despite local selling, CBOT.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up despite local selling, CBOT.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended up despite local selling and a down trend in the CBOT soycomplex.

"Locals sold 400 May at the close, there were hedges in July. Cargill and funds bought May and July early," a trader said. May WCE futures crush profit margin rose to -13.53 Thursday from -17.06 Wednesday. May-July spread at $2, May-Nov $58.50, July-Nov $59.50, Sep-Nov $8. Volume was 8,278 lots, with 623 hedges.
May canola rose $1 to $429.10, July rose $0.80 to $431.50. May flax rose $5 to $361. Commercials bought 50 July up $5.50 to $361.70. There were light hedges.
PCTS and UGG sold May feed pea contracts up US$5 at US$215.50 to RBC-DS, traders said. Volume was 80 lots.

May barley rose $2.70 to $144.50 after triggering commission buy stops at $143, July rose $2.50 to $142.50 after commission buy stops were hit at $141. RBC-DS bought October up $3.30 at $142, commercials traded 250 March 1998 at $140. Volume was 900 lots. Oats did not trade.
Commission houses bought May feed wheat up $3.80 at $174.30 as May-July spread at $3.50. Volume was 1,275 lots.
(All values in Canadian dollars, except feed peas)
